name: summer veg blanket pie
instructions:
Jamie Oliver's Summer Veg Blanket Pie (from Veg, p44). A one-pan summer vegetable braise — leek + new potatoes + butternut squash + courgette + chickpeas — caramelized with preserved lemon + rose harissa, lifted with saffron + sour cherries + macerated cherry tomatoes, then 'blanketed' with scrunched filo brushed in the tomato macerating juices and baked crisp. Served with strained yogurt drizzled with harissa oil.

UNTESTED — want to try. Written down as captured from Jamie's site.

SERVES 4. ~1.5 hours. Oven 190°C / 375°F. One large non-stick ovenproof frying pan.

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- 400g natural yoghurt
- 320g ripe cherry tomatoes
- extra virgin olive oil
- 1 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 4 cloves garlic
- 1 tbsp fennel seeds
- olive oil
- 1 large leek
- 320g new potatoes
- 320g butternut squash
- 320g courgettes (zucchini)
- 1/2 × 700g jar chickpeas (juices and all)
- 1 preserved lemon
- 1 tsp rose harissa (plus oil from the jar, for the yogurt)
- 50g dried sour cherries
- 1 pinch saffron
- 8 sheets filo pastry
- 1 tbsp sesame seeds
- sea salt + black pepper

=== PROCEDURE ===

1. STRAIN THE YOGURT: line a sieve with 3 pieces of kitchen paper, tip in the yoghurt, pull up the paper and very gently apply pressure so the liquid starts to drip through into a bowl. Leave to drain (thickens toward labneh territory).

2. MACERATE THE TOMATOES: halve the cherry tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, drizzle with 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil and the red wine vinegar. Toss and leave to macerate — this really brings out the flavour. RESERVE THE MACERATING JUICES later (they brush the filo).

3. PREHEAT the oven to 190°C / 375°F.

4. START THE PAN: peel and finely slice the garlic; place in a large non-stick ovenproof frying pan on medium heat with the fennel seeds and 2 tbsp olive oil. Fry a few minutes, stirring regularly.

5. PREP + ADD THE VEG AS YOU GO: trim, wash and slice the leek; scrub the potatoes, squash (deseed if needed) and courgettes and chop into 2cm chunks — adding everything to the pan as you go.

6. COVER AND COOK 15 MIN, shaking the pan occasionally. Then remove the lid, tip in the chickpeas (JUICES AND ALL), season lightly.

7. PRESERVED LEMON + HARISSA: finely chop the preserved lemon (discard pips), add to the pan with a drizzle of juice from its jar and the harissa. Fry a further 15 min, or until beautifully caramelised, stirring occasionally.

8. CHERRIES + SAFFRON: meanwhile, cover the sour cherries and saffron with 300ml boiling water; leave a few minutes, then add to the pan along with the macerated tomatoes (reserving the macerating juices).

9. THE FILO BLANKET: lay the filo flat, brush all over with the RESERVED TOMATO MACERATING JUICES. Roughly scrunch, wave and layer the filo over the pan, partly tucking it in at the edges — no need to be neat.

10. BAKE: scatter over the sesame seeds and bake 25 min until golden and crisp.

11. SERVE: transfer the strained yoghurt to a plate, drizzle with a little oil from the harissa jar, and serve alongside the pie.
notes:
Jamie Oliver, Veg (p44). Untested — captured to try. A very different pie from the cookbook's other pies: no crust-under, no gravy — a stovetop caramelized vegetable braise with a scrunched-filo 'blanket' crisped on top, all in one ovenproof pan.

=== WHAT'S INTERESTING ABOUT THIS RECIPE (WHY IT'S WORTH TRYING) ===

- THE FILO BLANKET: scrunched, wavy filo layered loosely on top instead of a rolled crust — maximum crisp surface area, zero pastry skill required, and it bakes right on the pan. A third pie-topping format alongside the cookbook's pie-crust / panko / mashed-potato options ([[turnip-yam-pie]], [[english-beer-lentils]]).
- FILO BRUSHED WITH TOMATO MACERATING JUICES instead of butter/oil alone — the seasoned vinegar-tomato-oil liquid flavors the crust while crisping it. Clever reuse of a byproduct.
- PRESERVED LEMON + ROSE HARISSA + SAFFRON + SOUR CHERRIES: a full north-african/persian flavor axis (salty-fermented citrus, floral chili, saffron, sweet-tart fruit) on a summer vegetable base. The sweet-savory dried-fruit move rhymes with the dried-cranberry direction in [[english-beer-lentils]]'s experiments.
- CHICKPEA JAR JUICES GO IN (aquafaba and all) — body for the braise.
- STRAINED YOGURT ON THE SIDE, drizzled with harissa-jar oil — the cooling counterpoint, same role yogurt plays in the indian curries.

=== JAMIE'S VEG PATTERN — SAME 320G PORTIONS ===

Same source cookbook as [[english-beer-lentils]]'s Allotment Cottage Pie. Note his 320g-per-vegetable portioning pattern (320g tomatoes / potatoes / squash / courgettes) — one 'veg portion' each per the book's framing.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[english-beer-lentils]]: the other Jamie Oliver pie in the cookbook (root veg + porcini + marmite under mash). Winter counterpart to this summer pie.
- [[turnip-yam-pie]]: the ATK-derived pot pie — crust-topping format comparison.
- [[ratatouille]]: the other summer-vegetable braise (courgette/squash family overlap), french register instead of this one's north-african lean.
